name: nowo-tech/page-builder-kit-bundle-assets

scripts.build: pnpm run build:canvas && pnpm run build:inline-edit && pnpm run build:admin && pnpm run build:css
scripts.build:css: mkdir -p src/Resources/public/css && cp src/Resources/assets/src/page-builder.css src/Resources/public/css/page-builder.css && cp node_modules/grapesjs/dist/css/grapes.min.css src/Resources/public/css/grapes.min.css && cp node_modules/grapick/dist/grapick.min.css src/Resources/public/css/grapick.min.css

description: Build and unit tests of the Page Builder Kit Bundle TypeScript (GrapesJS canvas, inline edit, admin media picker)
